title: Member Services Desk Manual, E.15 — Lodging Signed Pre-Buy Gallons on a Refined Fuels Account
content:
Where a member has signed for gallons ahead of the season on an account under Refined Fuels and Propane Accounts, those gallons are put to the member's own credit on the account as a single pre-buy booking line. The gallons go to the credit at the fixed price they are booked at, the money those gallons come to is committed on the booking, and the line is dated the day it is lodged. From then on the booked gallons stand to the member's credit, and fuel drawn against them is priced at the booked price rather than the price of the day.

The price the booked gallons are credited at is the price billed on the most recent will-call stop on or before the day the signed request was registered. A will-call stop is one the records show the member called in, and not one run to the automatic keep-full schedule, run as an emergency, run after hours or made to fill against a booking.

## Lodging the booking

The booking is lodged with `lodge_contract_gallon_booking_8fcb503b`. The gallons are the member's own commitment, so the desk unlocks the tool and hands it over for the customer themselves to run rather than running it for them.

### Parameters

| Parameter | What it is |
| --- | --- |
| `energy_account_id` | The internal reference number identifying the member's refined fuels or propane account the gallons are credited to, as the desk reads it back from the energy account lookup |
| `energy_order_id` | The internal reference number identifying the signed pre-buy request lodged with the energy desk that these gallons are being credited on, as the desk reads it back from the energy request lookup |
| `price_per_gallon` | The fixed price the booked gallons draw at, in USD per gallon to 4 decimal places, passed as a decimal number and stored as given |
| `booked_gallons` | The gallons going to the member's credit, in gallons to 1 decimal place, passed as a decimal number and stored as given with no further rounding |

### What comes back

A confirmation sentence naming the reference of the booking line written, the signed request it was credited on, the gallons put to the member's credit and the money committed on them in USD to 2 decimal places. Receiving that sentence is what indicates the gallons now stand to the member's credit on the account.

### Contract questions

**Does the booking line move money on the account?** It commits the money the booked gallons come to on the booking itself; the gallons stand to the member's credit from the day the line is dated.

**Is more than one booking written per call?** No. One call writes a single pre-buy booking line onto the account.
